title: Sudoku
summary: An installable Sudoku web app with graded puzzles, tutorial-style hints that teach solving techniques, and Apple Pencil Scribble input.
tagline: Graded puzzles and teaching hints, designed for iPad.
description: An offline-capable Sudoku app built for iPad and playable in any browser.

features.title: Genuinely graded puzzles
features.description: Generated in the browser and graded by the human techniques needed to solve them, so Easy through Very Hard reflect solving difficulty.

features.title: Hints that teach
features.description: Each hint names its solving technique, highlights the relevant cells and candidates, and can step through a multi-stage inference.

features.title: Play aids
features.description: Pencil marks, automatic candidate cleanup, candidate filling, remaining-digit counts, undo and redo, and optional highlighting.

features.title: Flexible input
features.description: Enter digits by touch, keyboard, or Apple Pencil Scribble.

features.title: Newspaper and book puzzles
features.description: Enter a custom puzzle manually or import a photo. Photo recognition runs on the device without uploading the image.

features.title: Picks up where you left off
features.description: Games save automatically, completion statistics are retained, and the app remains playable offline.

origin.title: Sudoku that feels natural on an iPad.
origin.body: I started this after a friend took up Sudoku. He was solving newspaper puzzles in pencil and already used an Apple Pencil for crosswords on his iPad, so it seemed obvious that he should be able to write into a Sudoku grid instead of tapping numbers on a keypad. Getting handwriting to feel ordinary in a browser took more work than I expected. An app I used regularly often had Very Hard puzzles that were easier than its Hard ones, so I graded puzzles by the techniques needed to solve them and built hints that name the technique and step through the reasoning. Later I added custom entry for puzzles from a newspaper or book, then photo import, which reads the puzzle on the device without uploading the image. Sudoku was also what finally got me to create apps.shadowfoot.com.
